reviews.text: The price is a bit high for what you get since it could be better in some areas.

I picked up this Galaxy Book3 at Best Buy last week after browsing online for a while. The 15 inch display on the base model is surprisingly crisp and bright for everyday tasks. Honestly though, I was hoping it might have had a spare SSD slot like the Ultra version does. There is definitely some room for improvement regarding the lack of an IR camera for face recognition since I rely on that. The sales associate was super helpful and made the whole buying process smooth and easy.

I was wondering if anyone else felt like the standard Galaxy Book3 is a bit of a middle ground between their other models. It definitely feels good for my daily work since it comes with the 13th Gen Intel Core i5 or i7 options. While the Ultra model gets all the hype for its webcam effects, I am just happy to have a reliable machine with the i5-1335U. Honestly, it could be better in some areas like the battery life and screen brightness compared to what I expected. Overall it seems like a solid choice for general use if you are not looking for the absolute top tier specs.

the 15 inch screen on this galaxy book3 is surprisingly crisp for the base model. delivery was super fast and the packaging was actually in perfect condition. just gotta deal with some minor quirks like the trackpad being a bit inconsistent sometimes.

I just got my new laptop and I am honestly feeling a bit frustrated already. I was really hoping this device would be perfect for my daily work from home setup. There is definitely room for improvement because I have encountered some minor issues with the performance that I did not expect. The Galaxy Book3 Ultra supports Windows Studio Effects with its 1080p webcam which is great, but the build quality feels just okay for the price. I will have to see if I can get this sorted out before I head back to the office tomorrow.

The price was a bit high for the build quality given the standard i5 and i7 processor options. Samsung's customer service was super helpful when I had a minor issue with the software. The shipping team actually called me to confirm the delivery time which was really nice. Overall the support experience has been great even though there were occasional inconsistencies.
The PROCESSOR options are great but the build quality feels like it needs ROOM for improvement. Overall the EXPERIENCE is positive though it could be better in some areas.
seriously the battery life could be better in some areas and i've had some minor issues with the touchpad. The 15.6 inch screen is sharp and the 13th gen intel core i7 processor runs super smooth.
The performance is great with the 13th Gen Intel Core i5-1335U and Core i7-1355U processor options available.
I'm trying to decide if the Galaxy Book3 is worth the upgrade for my daily work. The build quality feels a bit inconsistent with some occasional flex in the keyboard deck.

heads up the price is a bit steep but the build quality feels solid so i picked this up last week for work and it just feels right the service from the store was super helpful when i had questions honestly for the price you get is pretty good and the screen is great it is a good deal and the performance never really lags customer support was just okay nothing special really

Ok so the 13th Gen Intel Core i5-1335U and Core i7-1355U processor options make this standard Galaxy Book3 feel pretty fast for my daily tasks. While the build quality is solid, I did notice occasional inconsistencies that leave some room for improvement in the final product.

I just grabbed this Galaxy Book3 at Best Buy last week and honestly the build quality is GREAT for the PRICE. It's running super smooth with that 13th gen intel chip I saw listed on the box. But the customer service experience was kinda rough and there were some random inconsistencies when I tried to return it. Overall though the laptop feels SOLID and you definitely get good VALUE compared to other options out there.

Honestly i was super impressed with how smooth the service was when i placed my order online. delivery was pretty quick too which is rare these days. the price for the i7-1355u model feels totally fair compared to what other brands charge. i mainly use it for office work and streaming so i didnt need the crazy power of the ultra version. build quality is solid even though there are some minor issues i wish were fixed.

i've used macbooks before but the build quality on this galaxy book3 feels way more solid. overall experience has been pretty smooth so far with no major lag or crashes. customer service was super helpful when i had trouble setting up my account. there are occasional inconsistencies in performance and honestly it feels a bit pricey for what you get. just finished watching a movie and the webcam quality is decent thanks to those windows studio effects.

the price is pretty decent for the build quality which feels really solid. i use it every day for work and it handles everything smoothly without any lag. it's a bit pricey but the overall quality is definitely worth the cost. sometimes the experience feels a bit clunky and could be better in some areas.
the service was pretty disappointing honestly.

If you are looking for a laptop that handles daily tasks with ease, the Galaxy Book3 is a fantastic choice for most users. I have been using it for about a week now and honestly it feels pretty solid for my work. That said there is definitely some room for improvement regarding the overall build quality and screen brightness in this model. The price point is a bit steep for what you get but the processor speed is definitely worth the cost. Overall I am really happy with my purchase and would recommend it to anyone in the market for a new device.

The laptop feels okay for general tasks but lacks the wow factor. I have been using it for my daily office work and school projects for a few weeks now. The performance could be better in some areas especially when multitasking heavy apps. Samsung service was really helpful when I had questions about my new computer. I am disappointed that the build quality feels a bit cheap compared to other options.

I've been eyeing this laptop for a while now to see if it fits my daily grind. The processor options like the i5-1335U are FAST enough for my work without breaking the bank. I love how SMOOTH the system runs with those 13th Gen Intel chips. The build quality has some OCCASIONAL inconsistencies though, and the prices are just okay. Overall the Galaxy Book3 has been a solid EXPERIENCE for me so far.

I picked up this Galaxy Book3 last week at Best Buy and the 13th Gen Intel Core i7-1355U processor handles everything I throw at it effortlessly. It runs smoothly overall but there are some minor issues with the fan noise when running heavy apps that could use some improvement. I've been using the 15 inch display for most of my work and it feels just right for my desk setup.
I have been using the Galaxy Book3 for two months now and the service has been great. The 15.6 inch screen looks nice but I have encountered some minor issues with it.
The build quality feels CHEAP for the PRICE I paid. The customer service was a total DISASTER.
I am so excited about the 15 inch display and the overall build quality.

I decided to grab this laptop for my daily commute after my old one finally gave up the ghost. The Windows Studio Effects on the webcam really make my video calls look professional and polished. It is nice to see they offer the 13th Gen Intel Core i5 and i7 options for this standard model. Sometimes the screen just flickers for a second and the audio cuts out without any real reason. Overall it is a solid machine even though it has those occasional little quirks that bug me.

I wanted to love this laptop but my feelings are pretty mixed after using it for a while. The screen on the base model is a nice 15 inches and looks great for work. The display is sharp and the overall performance feels quite solid for daily tasks. Honestly I have noticed some occasional inconsistencies that are a bit annoying to deal with. The price point is a little steep for what you get even though the hardware is generally good.

I have been testing this laptop for about two weeks now. The 15 inch display on the base model looks great for my daily work. While the screen is nice, I did notice occasional inconsistencies in the performance. If you upgrade to the Ultra, the webcam features really make video calls feel professional.

Just got this thing opened and the 15.6-inch display is the first thing that hits you. The CORE i7 processor is seriously FAST and the screen looks crisp, though I noticed a few random glitches here and there. Overall the system just works great for my daily tasks without any major hiccups. It feels premium enough to justify the cost even if the price tag is a bit steep for what you get. I am REALLY happy with how smooth everything runs on this laptop.

So I finally pulled the trigger on the Galaxy Book3 after months of scrolling through specs. The video calls look crisp thanks to Windows Studio Effects on the 1080p camera. However, the support team was a bit confusing when I asked about the spare SSD slot. Performance also stutters occasionally, which is pretty annoying for everyday tasks. Luckily, the company sent a replacement unit pretty quickly after I filed the complaint.
